tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The night: the ground of every screen and of the canvas. Also the label color on Neon Pink fills (the wordmark bar).

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on ink: items, info blocks, attribute tiles, skill nodes.

tokens.name: panel2
tokens.usage: Selected or hovered surfaces: the selected tab, the update bar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders and dividers: card items, ghost buttons, tabs underline, settings rows.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings, on ink, panel and panel2 (16.6:1 on ink).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, hints, eyebrows, h3 labels, on ink and panel (7.7:1 on ink).

tokens.name: neon
tokens.usage: Neon Pink, the brand: primary buttons, the wordmark bar, character names in dialogue, the hacking cursor, your own HP bar and bad (unfair) buildings. As text on ink 5.9:1.

tokens.name: on-neon
tokens.usage: Label text on a Neon Pink fill (primary button, pressed segmented control). 5.9:1 on neon.

tokens.name: mana
tokens.usage: Mana Cyan: magic, tech and hacking. Mana bar, spell UI, ICE, rarity Tuned, the default focus ring. 11.1:1 on ink.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Street Gold: money, rewards, attention. Creds, feats, the special meter, rarity Prototype, the controller focus ring, points-to-spend dots.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Signal Green: safe, good, done. Fair-game door signs, healing, the hacking target window, stat increases.

tokens.name: karma
tokens.usage: Karma Violet: progress and the hidden. Karma bar, lore, hidden doors, the Lantern Vault.

tokens.name: fire
tokens.usage: Fire Orange (canvas): fire, explosions, burning, street crews.

tokens.name: siren
tokens.usage: Siren Red (canvas): heat stars and cop visors. Never for buttons.

tokens.name: legendary
tokens.usage: Legendary Orange: Black-market item names and LEGENDARY drops.

tokens.name: rarity-street
tokens.usage: Street (common) item names in lists.

tokens.name: ammo
tokens.usage: Bullets, muzzle flashes and the AMMO readout in the HUD.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: Hit sparks and the full special meter flash (canvas).

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Spent or unavailable text on the canvas: looted buildings, a runner who is out. 3.4:1 on ink, so decorative or paired with a word only.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Insets: the hacking track ground and the dark outline behind HUD bars and canvas text.

tokens.name: meter-bg
tokens.usage: Empty part of meters and HUD bars.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen title and the wordmark. Set as clamp(48px, 11vw, 84px) in code.

styles.name: wallet
styles.usage: Creds in shops and stat tiles, in gold, tabular figures.

styles.name: hud
styles.usage: Canvas HUD, 11–15px, uppercase, with a 3px dark outline in track.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Two shadowrunners, a fixer with a grudge and five districts.
styles.usage: Running text in menus and dialogue; max 62ch.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Item descriptions and settings hints, in muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Attribute and stat labels, uppercase, muted.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The line above a title, uppercase, muted.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Attribute tile inner gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tab gap, key-table row gap, info-block gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Item action gap, tab underline padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: List gap, attribute grid gap, skill row gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Button row gap, item inner gap, tab and small-button padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Card gap, item horizontal padding, settings-row gap.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Key-table column gap, two-column help gap.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card vertical padding, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Card horizontal padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Meters.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, tabs, the hacking track.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Items, info blocks, tiles, skill nodes, segmented controls, the pause button.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The update bar.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Touch buttons, dots.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Things that float over play: the update bar.

tokens.name: shadow-cursor
tokens.usage: The hacking cursor's neon glow.

tokens.name: shadow-pad-focus
tokens.usage: Halo around the gold controller focus ring.

tokens.name: shadow-chroma
tokens.usage: Reference only: the wordmark's chromatic split is a text-shadow with these offsets.

control.note: Touch-control sizes. Settings switches S / M / L (body.size-s, default, body.size-l).

tokens.name: control-face
tokens.usage: PUNCH, KICK, JUMP (M). S 50px, L 68px.

tokens.name: control-small
tokens.usage: GUN, SPELL, DODGE, MED, ★, CHAR (M). S 42px, L 56px.

tokens.name: control-stick
tokens.usage: Stick ring diameter (M). S 116px, L 152px.

tokens.name: control-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any button on a coarse pointer.
